title: The ambient datum relative to the bounded comparison class
statement:
For the bounded constructible coefficient class at $A=A_{E,n}$, the
vanishing input is [thm-sf-fullcd-class] and the exceptional adjoint
relative to that class is [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. Thus the
bounded-class uses of clause (1) of
[def-weil-exceptional-adjoint-admissibility] have this concrete
interpretation. The unrestricted ambient datum of
[def-weil-ambient-exceptional-adjoint] is not asserted here; it is false in
general (an elliptic curve over $\overline{\mathbf F}_p$ with
$A=\mathbf F_r$, rem:sf-ambient-counterexample in the six-functors chapter),
and the constructible exceptional adjoint of
def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image is what the blueprint uses.

proof.text: Prove the two clauses of sfClassFullCohomologicalDimension by the argument underlying [thm-sf-fullcd-class]. For an arbitrary pullback p of c.g and an etale-origin sheaf M, write M as comparison inverse image of M0 up to isomorphism. Etale.isZero_higherDirectImage_of_isPullback_of_isProper gives vanishing above 2d. Transport this zero object through exact comparison inverse image, the single-functor comparison, rightDerivedLowerStarComparisonIso′, and the homology comparison. The identity square gives the absolute clause, and etaleOrigin_upperStar_obj gives the origin witness after the prescribed pro-etale base change. This uses the underlying proof rather than the published full-class theorem because that theorem has an unused invertible-exponent hypothesis.

source.place: Proof, combining class vanishing with the relative adjunction

proof.text: Use the fixed compact-support comparison from [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. Transport the ordinary etale adjunction to the given compactification by Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekIso. Define eps at bounded-below L as the fixed comparison at f-times Rnu-star L, followed by comparison inverse image of the etale counit and then the derived comparison counit. The target of the etale exceptional functor is bounded below by plus_etaleRightDerivedUpperShriek_obj. Naturality of the fixed comparison and the two counits proves naturality of eps. The formula in [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] identifies the transported right functor literally with sfFiniteExceptionalFixed.

source.place: Proof, combining class vanishing with the relative adjunction

proof.text: For a bounded-below etale representative K0, compose the inverses of the ordinary etale adjunction and derived comparison adjunction Hom equivalences, and precompose with the fixed compact-support comparison. Naturality of that comparison proves that this composite is g mapped by compact support followed by eps, after precomposition with the map on Hom sets induced by comparison inverse image. That map is bijective on the bounded-below exceptional target by comparison full faithfulness, so the required map is bijective. For general K in the essential image, choose its representative isomorphism and conjugate the source and target Hom maps by it and its compact-support image. These are bijections; functoriality identifies their composite with the required map. Combine this result, counit naturality, and the vanishing from the first step. No all-object ambient adjunction is used.
